outcome: routine labour and vaginal birth care
cohort: The study evaluates maternal health services within 19 hospitals in Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan, focusing on improvements in the quality of care provided.
finding: A two-year quality improvement intervention resulted in significant improvements in various aspects of maternal health care quality, including labour management, obstetric care, infection control, and infrastructure, in hospitals across Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan.
mod_finding: The intervention led to significant improvements in caesarean section management in Kyrgyzstan and routine labour and vaginal birth care in Tajikistan.
